name: Editorial
description: Warm paper, ink typography and hairline rules — a print-magazine feel with large serif headlines
descriptionZh: 暖色纸张、墨色排版与细线分隔，大号衬线标题带来印刷杂志感
author: core

keyProperties.explanation: A high-contrast editorial serif with optical sizes, from headline to body
keyProperties.explanationZh: 带光学尺寸的高对比衬线字体，标题和正文都耐看，是编辑风的核心

keyProperties.explanation: Hairline rules instead of shadows keep the structure calm
keyProperties.explanationZh: 细线分隔代替阴影，结构清晰克制

keyProperties.explanation: Off-white paper tones feel like print, not a screen
keyProperties.explanationZh: 米白纸张色降低屏幕感，更像印刷品
